answer: An agent marketplace makes every seller identity, including ember, plume and pulse, lock a $100 bond for 30 days before bidding. Signed commitments let buyers prove when a seller accepts payment but misses its delivery deadline, triggering bond forfeiture. Creating names is cheap, but operating 1,000 eligible sybils ties up $100,000, incurs financing costs, and puts that capital at risk if the accounts cheat.
